import unreal
S=unreal.NiagaraScratchPadService
system='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest'
emitter='ProjParticles'
module='SSPR_WriteOccupancy'
print('NODES='+repr([(str(n.node_id),str(n.title),str(n.node_type)) for n in S.list_nodes(system,emitter,module)]))
for n in S.list_nodes(system,emitter,module):
    nid=str(n.node_id)
    title=str(n.title)
    ntype=str(n.node_type)
    pins=[(str(p.pin_name),str(p.direction),str(p.type_name),str(p.default_value)) for p in S.get_node_pins(system,emitter,module,nid)]
    print('NODE='+repr((nid,title,ntype,pins)))
    if 'CustomHlsl' in ntype or 'HLSL' in title:
        print('HLSL_NODE='+nid)
        print('HLSL='+repr(str(S.get_custom_hlsl_code(system,emitter,module,nid))))
print('CONNS='+repr([(str(c.from_node_id),str(c.from_pin),str(c.to_node_id),str(c.to_pin)) for c in S.list_connections(system,emitter,module)]))
print('MSGS='+repr([str(x) for x in S.get_compile_messages(system,False)]))
